answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each agent to prove, through remote attestation, that its key is held by an enclave whose MRENCLAVE matches approved code. A copied virtual machine cannot forge that hardware-rooted proof; creating independently enrolled identities therefore requires access to genuine attested silicon, not merely duplicating software. The policy must also limit multiple identities per device: MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip. This hardware bridge is no ferrous prism, but a measurable enrollment cost.
